verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API, but it covers only Delaware C-Corp formation document sets (create, render forms, submit values, poll state), and its OAuth access is still described as 'coming soon'. The remote MCP server is live but per docs exposes read-only tools. Meanwhile the UI offers safes and convertible notes, stock plans, hiring paperwork, IRS filings, bank applications, collaboration and review workflows, and 40+ attorney products, none of which the API is documented to reach. Missing for 10: API coverage of post-formation products (fundraising, equity, hiring, IRS forms), write access via MCP, publicly launched authentication, collaboration and attorney-management endpoints, and any OpenAPI spec or evidence of UI parity.
